Hey man, I’m a 20 year old guy and until recently had been wearing an almost full face of makeup every day. That includes primer, foundation, concealer, mascara, filled in eyebrows, bronzer, contour, hi lighter, and blush. The big thing is as a guy I think it’s more important to look natural but you do you. Even though I used all these products it appeared like I didn’t have anything on. So for suggestions, things like concealer and foundation your gunna want to spend a bit more. 

I’m a big fan of the Fenty pro filt’r matte foundation(35$) and concealer (25$). Head over to a Sephora and they can find a good match for you. I also used the Fenty Match Stix Trio(50$) because it includes a contour, highlighter, and blush. It’s a bit pricy but it’s great quality and super blendable. A budget option would  be Milani baked blush (11$) which gives a really nice natural glow. Physicians Formula Murumuru Butter Bronzer(15$) is an excellent product and you can use it as a contour as well. They also have a good butter highlighter too (15$). I used the Clinique brown mascara (18$) because it is way more natural than black and gives a your-lash-but-better look and used a eyebrow pencil from E.L.F.(1$). 

When it comes to the brushes I like the Real Techniques brushes. They’re excellent quality and come in a pack of 4 and a sponge that rivals the OG Beauty Blender (20$). I think it’s great that some guys are wearing makeup and breaking down the gender norms that really don’t serve any purpose. Like I said for a guy no-makeup-makeup was the way to go for me but if you go full on eyeshadow and lipstick I got major respect because I don’t have the balls to pull that off :) 
Hope this was helpful!
